source_handle: Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodine disinfection was performed, and 2% lidocaine was used to anesthetize the inferior alveolar nerve tissue. After the anesthesia took effect, the gums were separated, the roots were divided, and the loose teeth were extracted. The extraction socket was routinely scraped, reset, and sutured to stop bleeding.
